content.short: Every Ada Time Stamp (ATS) will give the ability to leave a lasting impression on a moment in time.
content.description:
For the first time it is possible to purchase moments in time defined in terms of Cardano’s blockchain protocol. These are NFTs known as ATS. Starting with Cardano’s genesis block in September 2017 until today, you can own these defined moments in time.

We provide the ability for history to be collectively written, owned, and managed. Through Ada’s Museum, anyone can paint the shared canvas of time. Like layers of paint, every new piece of content placed on an individual ATS is placed ‘on top’. New content is displayed first while older content is stored by the individual ledger of a given ATS.
